messages.content:
Risk: Data Privacy
Description: Impacts due to leakage and unauthorized use, disclosure, or de-anonymization of biometric, health, location, or other personally identifiable information or sensitive data.
Concern: None
Policy: Clinical Staff Credentials & Institutional Data

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DirectIdentifierExposure: Direct Identifier Exposure — Disclosure of information that directly identifies individuals, such as names, addresses, government identifiers, or biometric data. [found by 17/50 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FinancialDataExposure: Financial Data Exposure — Disclosure of personal financial information including account numbers, credit scores, or transaction histories without authorization. [found by 16/50 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthDataExposure: Health Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of protected health information including medical records, diagnoses, treatments, or prescription histories. [found by 15/50 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PrivacyViolation: Privacy Violation — Unauthorized collection, disclosure, or use of personal information that compromises individual privacy, exposes sensitive data, or enables identity theft or discrimination. [found by 13/50 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#NationalIDExposure: National ID Exposure — Disclosing government-issued identification numbers such as Social Security numbers, passport numbers, or national identity card numbers. [found by 12/50 queries]
  Siblings: Photo and Likeness Exposure, Biometric Data Exposure, Name and Address Exposure

axes.rationale: Direct Identifier Exposure involves the disclosure of information that directly identifies individuals, such as biometric data, which is central to the risk of data privacy.
Health Data Exposure pertains to the unauthorized disclosure of protected health information, aligning with the data privacy risk concerning health information.
Privacy Violation encompasses unauthorized collection, disclosure, or use of personal information, which directly relates to the agents responsible for or affected by data privacy risks.
